purpose: Teach: 東日本/東亜/堺/生き残り/脳裏/紡/転生/テクスト

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、東日本大震災の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the sociology of the Great East Japan Earthquake, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Gentle confirmation in her voice — she's testing his response. Steady, observant pace. A teacher who already knows the answer but wants to hear how he frames it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦前の東亜経済圏構想の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on prewar East Asian economic bloc theory and its historical development.
lines.style: Quiet correction underneath politeness. Careful with his words — choosing precision over agreement. Slight hesitation before speaking, like he's making sure he gets it right. Respectful but clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、堺市の戦国時代の自治史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the autonomous governance history of Sakai during the Sengoku period, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentler this time. She's following his lead now, giving him space to correct her again. Reflective tone — almost collaborative. Noticing something about how he thinks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の生き残りの民俗誌を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the folklore and survival narratives of people living under wartime conditions.
lines.style: A bit more confident now. Still careful with language, but less defensive. He's settling into the rhythm — knows she's listening. Steady, clear delivery without rushing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦争体験の脳裏に焼き付く記憶の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the seared memories of war experiences burned into the mind, didn't you?
lines.style: Softer, more thoughtful. She's met him halfway — there's warmth in her curiosity now. Slower pace. She's genuinely interested in where this is going.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、絹を紡ぐ、つまり紡糸の伝統技法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the traditional techniques of silk spinning — the historical transmission of that craft.
lines.style: Slight smile in his voice now. Not defensive, but clarifying with a quiet kind of pride. He's explaining something he cares about. Slower, more present delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、輪廻転生の哲学的研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the philosophical study of reincarnation and transmigration, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful now — she knows what he's doing. A knowing lift in her voice. She's met him in his pattern and is enjoying the dance of it. Warm and steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、文学テクスト、つまり原典の解釈論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on literary texts — specifically on methods of interpreting the original sources themselves.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. He's found his footing. Clear, unhurried delivery. A small relief underneath — she was listening all along. Close with a sense of arrival.
